repo_notes.author: DevinWorkshop maintainers
repo_notes.content: PiggyMetrics is a legacy reference implementation of microservices on Spring Boot 2.0.3 / Spring Cloud Finchley with Netflix OSS (Eureka, Zuul, Ribbon, Hystrix, Turbine) and OAuth2 (spring-security-oauth2). Readers are engineers learning the architecture and planning modernization, so explain how the pieces interact at runtime rather than restating the README. Treat config/src/main/resources/shared/*.yml as the source of truth for ports, routes, timeouts, cron expressions and service URLs, and cite it. Ports: gateway 4000 (published as 80), registry 8761, config 8888, auth-service 5000 (/uaa), account-service 6000 (/accounts), statistics-service 7000 (/statistics), notification-service 8000 (/notifications), per-service MongoDB 27017. Feign clients: account-service -> auth-service and statistics-service (with fallback), notification-service -> account-service, statistics-service -> exchangeratesapi.io (with fallback).

repo_notes.author: DevinWorkshop maintainers
repo_notes.content: Clearly flag anything legacy, end-of-life, or broken today instead of describing it as current. Specifically: the build requires JDK 8; every Dockerfile uses the java:8-jre base image, which has been removed from Docker Hub (eclipse-temurin:8-jre is the replacement); Travis CI (dist: trusty, oraclejdk8) and the sqshq/* Docker Hub images are from the upstream project and are not maintained here; api.exchangeratesapi.io now requires an access key, so the UI (launch.js) shows NaN and statistics-service cannot get rates; the ELK stack described in the README is not part of this repository. Spring Boot 2.0.x, Spring Cloud Finchley, Zuul 1, Ribbon and Hystrix are end-of-life or in maintenance mode.

repo_notes.author: DevinWorkshop maintainers
repo_notes.content: Writing conventions: parent pages are short navigation summaries (what the section covers and how its child pages relate, plus one diagram) and must not repeat child page content. Every service page follows the same structure: responsibility, REST endpoints (method, path, auth scope), domain model and MongoDB collections, configuration keys, outbound calls (Feign/Ribbon/Hystrix), and tests. Prefer sequence diagrams for request flows and tables for ports, routes, endpoints and config. Don't spend detail on static assets such as fonts, images and CSS.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Purpose of PiggyMetrics, the functional vs infrastructure service split, a service topology diagram, the Maven module map, and a guide to the rest of the wiki

pages.title: Architecture & Service Topology
pages.purpose: How services are wired at runtime: Config Server bootstrap, Eureka registration, Zuul routing, OAuth2 token flow, RabbitMQ for Turbine, and startup ordering/healthchecks in docker-compose.yml

pages.title: End-to-End Request Flows
pages.purpose: Sequence diagrams for the main user and system flows across gateway, auth-service, account-service, statistics-service and notification-service

page_notes.content: Cover at least: (1) login - browser obtains a password-grant token from /uaa/oauth/token through the gateway; (2) registration - POST /accounts/ creates the user in auth-service via AuthServiceClient, then creates the account; (3) saving the account - PUT /accounts/current then StatisticsServiceClient.updateStatistics, with StatisticsServiceClientFallback when statistics is down; (4) the notification scheduled jobs (backup and remind) calling account-service with client-credentials tokens. Cite the controllers, Feign clients and services involved.

pages.title: Getting Started & Local Development
pages.purpose: Build and run the system locally: prerequisites, mvn package, docker-compose.yml plus docker-compose.dev.yml, the .env password variables, exposed ports and important URLs

page_notes.content: State the prerequisites explicitly: JDK 8 (newer JDKs fail with Boot 2.0.3), Maven, Docker with Compose. Explain the difference between production mode (pulls sqshq/* images) and development mode (builds local images and publishes service and Mongo ports). Include a table of every published port from both compose files. Mention that java:8-jre must be replaced or retagged (e.g. eclipse-temurin:8-jre) for docker compose --build to work, and link to Known Issues & Workarounds.

pages.title: Known Issues & Workarounds
pages.purpose: Things that are broken or outdated when running the repository today, with symptoms, root cause in code/config, and the workaround

page_notes.content: One entry per issue: removed java:8-jre base image; exchangeratesapi.io requiring an access key (NaN in the UI from launch.js, missing rates in ExchangeRatesServiceImpl); Hystrix dashboard stream URL must be http://turbine-stream-service:8080/turbine/turbine.stream because the dashboard proxies the stream server-side; Travis CI pipeline not active; JDK 8 requirement; the default passwords in .env are for development only. Use a table with Symptom / Cause / Workaround columns.

pages.title: Business Microservices

pages.title: Statistics Service

pages.title: Notification Service

pages.title: Domain Model & Data Normalization

pages.title: Security & Authentication
pages.purpose: Short summary of the OAuth2 model: auth-service as authorization server, functional services as resource servers, password grant for the UI and client-credentials grant for service-to-service calls

pages.title: Auth Service (Authorization Server)
pages.purpose: auth-service: OAuth2AuthorizationConfig clients and scopes, WebSecurityConfig, MongoUserDetailsService, user registration endpoint, token store, and tests

pages.title: Resource Servers & Token Propagation
pages.purpose: How each functional service validates tokens (ResourceServerConfig, CustomUserInfoTokenServices, user-info-uri), scope-based method security, and how Feign clients obtain and forward client-credentials tokens

pages.title: Infrastructure Services
pages.purpose: Short summary of config, registry, MongoDB and RabbitMQ and the startup dependencies between them

pages.title: Config Server & Centralized Configuration
pages.purpose: Config Server with the native profile and classpath:/shared, bootstrap.yml in every client, the shared application.yml defaults, per-service files, and @RefreshScope/refresh for dynamic changes

page_notes.content: Include a configuration reference table per service: port, context path, Mongo database, Hystrix/Ribbon timeouts, cron expressions, external URLs, and the environment variables each property reads (CONFIG_SERVICE_PASSWORD, ACCOUNT/STATISTICS/NOTIFICATION_SERVICE_PASSWORD as OAuth2 client secrets, MONGODB_PASSWORD). Note that the SMTP credentials in notification-service.yml are hardcoded placeholders (dev-user/dev-password).

pages.title: Service Registry (Eureka)
pages.purpose: registry module: Eureka server setup, client registration settings, how Feign/Ribbon/Zuul resolve serviceIds, and the Eureka dashboard on 8761

pages.title: MongoDB Containers & Data Seeding
pages.purpose: mongodb image: Dockerfile, init.sh user creation, account-service-dump.js demo data, one database per service, and embedded Mongo used in tests

pages.title: Resilience & Observability

pages.title: Inter-Service Communication: Feign, Ribbon & Hystrix
pages.purpose: Every Feign client, its target, whether it has a fallback and what the fallback returns; Ribbon load balancing; Hystrix timeouts (10000 ms default in shared application.yml, 20000 ms and Ribbon timeouts in gateway.yml) and what a user sees when a downstream service fails

page_notes.content: Present the Feign clients as a table: client, caller module, target, fallback class. Explain the timeout interplay between Hystrix and Ribbon (the README shows a log warning about it).

pages.title: Monitoring: Hystrix Dashboard & Turbine
pages.purpose: monitoring (Hystrix Dashboard) and turbine-stream-service (Turbine over RabbitMQ, WebFlux/Netty): how metrics reach the dashboard and which stream URL to enter

pages.title: Logging & Distributed Tracing
pages.purpose: Spring Cloud Sleuth traceId/spanId in logs across services, Docker log rotation in docker-compose.yml, and what the README's ELK section describes versus what is actually in the repo

pages.title: Gateway & Web Frontend
pages.purpose: Short summary of the Zuul edge service and the static single-page UI it serves

pages.title: Zuul Gateway & API Routes
pages.purpose: gateway module: @EnableZuulProxy, the route table from gateway.yml (path, serviceId or url, stripPrefix, sensitive headers), timeouts, and how auth headers pass through

pages.title: Frontend SPA
pages.purpose: Static UI in gateway/src/main/resources/static: launch.js, login.js, main.js, dashboard.js responsibilities, token storage, the API calls each makes, and the client-side exchange-rate dependency; summarize CSS/fonts/images in one short paragraph

pages.title: REST API Reference

pages.title: Testing Strategy
pages.purpose: How the code is tested: unit tests with Mockito, MockMvc controller tests, repository tests on embedded MongoDB (flapdoodle), Feign fallback tests, application context tests; JaCoCo coverage; commands to run all or per-module tests; gaps such as no integration or contract tests

page_notes.content: Cover the test classes per module (account-service, auth-service, statistics-service, notification-service, gateway, monitoring, turbine-stream-service) and the src/test/resources/*.yml overrides that disable Config/Eureka during tests. Quick smoke test: mvn -B test -pl account-service,auth-service with JDK 8.
